input.prompt: One continuous loop. The woman walks calmly toward the camera at an unhurried, steady pace, holding the empty birdcage at her side. The camera dollies backward at exactly her walking speed, so she stays the same size and in the same place in the frame the whole time; only her stride, her swinging arm, her hair and her dress move. A steady wind keeps lifting her long hair and the hem of her red dress. The crowd of men in dark suits keeps hurrying past her and away from the camera, briefcases swinging, an endless flow. She keeps looking straight into the lens. Steady, even motion from start to end, no change of pace, no cuts. The shot ends exactly as it began, so it loops seamlessly. Grainy black-and-white 35mm film look throughout; the red dress stays the only color.
